name: Kaseifu Onihei ~Sumikomi Joshiryou de Shuchinikurin~
original_name: 家政夫鬼平 ～住み込み女子寮で酒池肉林～
source:
Onihei is a housekeeper. He starts working at a school dormitory for girls. Surrounded by girls..., great! Well, who goes first...?
